portraits.name: Product Lead
portraits.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one individual 1:1 square profile portrait PNG for the SodaOS role-avatar collection. Reference image 1 is the approved ten-character roster; it supplies the exact cast and visual style. Generate ONE single portrait, not a sheet or collage. Match the specified character's identity, face, hair, clothing silhouette, age and expression from the roster. Preserve the accepted PS1-era low-poly 3D aesthetic: visibly angular faceted geometry, chunky polygon hair and clothing, low-resolution painted textures, simple baked lighting, restrained pixel texture and dithering. Keep it consistent with the reference rather than making it smoother or photorealistic. Composition: head-and-shoulders portrait at a consistent scale, entire head and hairstyle comfortably inside frame with a little headroom, face clearly readable and centered for a circular avatar crop, shoulders cropped at bottom, eyes unobstructed, a slight three-quarter pose. Full-bleed square background. One dominant assigned hue across clothing, backdrop, lighting and shadows, with the reference's warm readable facial tones. Background is simple, softly dithered and tonal, with no scenery competing with the face. No text, role labels, border, frame, grid, logos, watermark, robots, extra people or UI. Output must be a standalone square 1:1 image, ideally 1024×1024.

Character to generate: Product Lead, located at top row, first panel of reference image 1. Identity: the confident woman with an angular black bob, gold geometric earrings, red lips, and a sharply shaped red jacket over a dark top; composed, decisive expression. Role cue: no prop. Approved dominant color: #DF001B. Make this role's assigned hue unmistakable in its background and clothing; preserve light and dark tonal depth.
Deliver only this one character portrait with no lettering.
